title: Short Duration Electrical Stimulation to Improve Outcomes After Cubital Tunnel Release (SELECT) Trial
official: Short Duration Electrical Stimulation to Improve Outcomes After Cubital Tunnel Release (SELECT) Trial
summary: A novel temporary peripheral nerve stimulation system that delivers electrical stimulation therapy in a cubital tunnel release model will be evaluated for feasibility.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Ulnar neuropathy at the elbow

Exclusion Criteria:

* Peripheral neuropathy outside of nerve of interest
* Patients with any active implanted device
